Each is { id, form, title, body: [lines] } in the letters' light markup (src/ui/journal-letters.js); an empty line starts a new paragraph. Under 60 words each. words.entryLineMany: In your own hand, since the morning you came.
words.title: Keeper's pages

pages.title: The first page
body: I came in on the morning tide. The land here is new, still pale from the sea.
Keepers don't own the islands we tend. We help them hold what comes, and write down what we see.
Someone will read this after me. Start at the spring.

pages.title: What a keeper does
body: A keeper doesn't build. A keeper tends.
Shape the land and let the tide shape it back. Make room for water, plants and shelter, and the creatures will find it, each in its own time.
The island grows while you are away: ebb, and flow, and ebb again.
